params.2095: Special: I Eat Dagannoths For Breakfast
params.2184:
What if all the dagannoth bosses were fought in one go? Switching combat styles and surviving is no easy feat. A warrior could, in theory, defeat them using one combat style, but it would certainly be no quick battle, if possible at all!

You will be pitched against: the original dagannoth mother, the second dagannoth mother and 2 dagannoth sentinels; all at once.

If you don't have the normal spellbook active, it will become active when you start this battle, and will revert afterwards.

There are no handicaps applied.

Quests required to play: Horror from the Deep, Blood Runs Deep.
